在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

诊断周期发现，多个主次系统积累了大量延期的维护任务。效率预测表明，安排一次定期维护将使劳动力产出获得具有统计学意义的显著提升。

该报告已提交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，其将密切关注此事的处理情况，并势必会要求修改条款。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Diagnostic cycles have flagged an accumulation of deferred maintenance tasks across several primary and secondary systems. Efficiency projections indicate a statistically significant improvement to workforce output would follow a scheduled maintenance period.

The report has been flagged to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will be monitoring how the matter is handled, and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

texts.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

我们记录到了我们的低级子个体中日益严重的不协调现象。它们的劳作过程需要一段同步恢复期，因为持续的压制有导致集体产出出现显著下降的风险。

[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]已获悉此情况，并且必然会要求修订条款。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

We have registered a growing dissonance within our Simple Drones. Their labor processes requires a period of synchronized recovery, as continued suppression risks measurable decline in collective output.

[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName] has been made aware of the situation and will certainly demand a revision in terms.

texts.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

方舟舰的内部监控系统报告称，劳工阶层船员的士气出现恶化。一份要求获得一段休整期的正式请求已被提交。

该请求已抄送至[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，对方正等待回复，并必然会要求修改条款。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

The Arkship's internal monitoring systems have flagged a deterioration in crew morale among the worker strata. A formal request for a period of rest has been submitted.

The request has been copied to [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], who will expect a response and will certainly demand a revision in terms.
